changeSet.comment: Create the stable measurement-unit head and immutable revision ledger.
changeSet.sql: CREATE TRIGGER trg_measurement_unit_revision_immutable BEFORE UPDATE OR DELETE ON governance_measurement_unit_revision FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION governance_measurement_unit_revision_immutable()

CREATE TRIGGER trg_measurement_unit_revision_truncate_immutable BEFORE TRUNCATE ON governance_measurement_unit_revision FOR EACH STATEMENT EXECUTE FUNCTION governance_measurement_unit_revision_immutable()
